description: FULL BODY. A male Malaysian police inspector in his late 30s. He is wearing a crisp, dark blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) service uniform with silver rank pips on the shoulders and a name tag. He has short, neat black hair and an authoritative, professional appearance. He is wearing black tactical trousers and polished black boots.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his late 60s. He has thinning grey hair and a gentle, slightly weathered face. He is wearing a traditional patterned batik shirt in soft blue tones, loose-fitting dark grey trousers, and brown leather sandals. He represents a vulnerable but dignified Malaysian senior citizen.

FULL BODY. A featureless, anonymous human silhouette glowing with a faint digital grid pattern. The figure is an opaque dark grey, lacking any facial features or skin texture. It wears a translucent, glitching digital headset to signify its role as a fraudulent caller.

FULL BODY. A featureless, robotic humanoid figure with a matte metallic surface. The figure is entirely anonymous and lacks a face. It is distinguished by a red-glowing badge-like icon on its chest and digital artifacts hovering around its limbs to indicate its synthetic, fraudulent nature.
